tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the 60 APIs/SDKs we track and the package names to query them by. Free.

tools.name: preview_changes
tools.description: Latest five breaking/deprecation/security headlines across all sources, to check freshness. Free.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Free. Before writing code against a library you may know only from older training data, check whether it changed since that version: verdict, major versions crossed, how many breaking changes, deprecations and security fixes, and the top three breaking headlines. Call upgrade_check (paid) for the fu

tools.name: upgrade_check
tools.description: What changed in a package since the version your code targets: breaking changes, deprecations, security fixes and major versions crossed, with the sentence that triggered each label. Call this before writing code against a library you may know only from older training data. Costs $0.01 (x402, USDC).

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Normalized change records (breaking, deprecation, security, release) for one tracked API/SDK or all of them, filterable by date and kind. Costs $0.005 (x402, USDC).

tools.name: digest
tools.description: Everything breaking, deprecated or security-related across all tracked sources since a date, grouped by source. Costs $0.02 (x402, USDC).
